trailhead.label: Lisignago (church of San Biagio), the APT’s start

cautions: A long climb of 600 m on forest roads.
SAT path 416 drops steeply back to the village: take it slowly with your dog.
The viewpoint is above steep ground: keep your dog on a short lead there.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
